text: Volume is not my gate: day_vol is only my partial range-contraction proxy (R5), and day_vol 0.24 reads as a quiet reaction, not a breakout bar I must confirm. MDT is a retracement resolving with the trend (W and D hh_hl_3 HH/HL, dist_to_20bar_high_pct 1.07); the hour must take yesterday's high first (H1 pos_in_day_range_pct 39.1). I stand behind h1_close_above:bar_high, ACT_NOW, wrong on a daily close below bar_low, and no follow-through in 3 bars means wrong (C11). A 1.4x volume test is the volume seats' condition; I would not object to it.
